FX-CHECK-001.says: The settings as they start: anchor in the middle, (50, 50) per cent, Width Slider 64, white, opacity 100, blending mode none: the cell that starts at the anchor runs off the bottom-right, so the top-left and bottom-right quarters are white and the other two clear; the cel itself is gone.

FX-CHECK-002.says: Width 4: white squares 4 pixels across in a checker, the anchor (8, 5) on a corner of them, the others clear.

FX-CHECK-003.says: Width 4 with the anchor at (53.125, 55) per cent, (8.5, 5.5) pixels: the edges run through pixel centres, so the pixels on them are half white.

FX-CHECK-004.says: Width & Height Sliders, width 4 and height 2: rectangles 4 across and 2 down.

FX-CHECK-005.says: Corner Point, the corner at (75, 70) per cent, (12, 7) pixels: rectangles 4 by 2, FX-CHECK-004's.

FX-CHECK-006.says: Corner Point with the corner on the anchor: each cell held at 1 pixel, a checker of single pixels.

FX-CHECK-007.says: Width 4, feather width 2: the upright edges ramp over 2 pixels, the level ones stay sharp.

FX-CHECK-008.says: Width 4, both feathers 4: no pixel wholly white or wholly clear, a soft weave.

FX-CHECK-009.says: Width 4, orange #ff8000 at opacity 50: orange squares at half covering.

FX-CHECK-010.says: Width 4, normal: white squares over the cel, the cel showing in the clear ones.

FX-CHECK-011.says: Width 4, violet #6450a0, multiply: the cel darkened and tinted in the squares, as it was in the others.

FX-CHECK-012.says: Width 4, violet, screen: the cel lightened in the squares.

FX-CHECK-013.says: Width 4, violet, add: the violet added in the squares.

FX-CHECK-016.says: Width 4, stencil alpha: the cel shows only through the squares.

FX-CHECK-017.says: Width 4, normal at opacity 0: the cel exactly as it was.

FX-CHECK-018.says: Width 4, the anchor keyed from (50, 50) at frame 0 to (75, 50) at frame 4, linear: the squares slide right, 1 pixel a frame; frame 4, moved one square, is the clear and white swapped.

FX-CHECK-019.says: Width keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: the squares grow; frame 2 is width 5.

FX-CHECK-020.says: FX-CHECK-010 moved three pixels right: the squares move with the layer.

FX-CHECK-021.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the anchor is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-CHECK-002's.

FX-CHECK-022.says: FX-CHECK-009 with its colour in capitals, #FF8000: the same.

FX-CHECK-023.says: Width 3, the anchor at (-100, -100) per cent, outside the drawing: the checker still lies across the whole layer.

FX-CHECK-024.says: Opacity keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 past its end by an ease, width 4, none: held at 0, frame 4 is clear everywhere.

FX-CHECK-025.says: Width 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-026.says: Height 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-027.says: Feather width -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-028.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-029.says: Anchor 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-030.says: Size From "corner", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-031.says: Blending mode "darken", which this program does not have. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-032.says: Colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHECK-033.says: Width keyed to 10001 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
